text: この　ところ　タマムシ　シティの　ほう　でも　いねむり　ポケモンが　あらわれる　そうだよ

structure.jp: タマムシ　シティの　ほう　でも
いねむり　ポケモンが　あらわれる

patterns.name: 〜そうだ (hearsay)
patterns.span: あらわれる　そうだ
patterns.explanation: そうだ after a plain verb says you are passing on something you heard from others. あらわれる そうだ = 'I hear it shows up'.

patterns.name: 〜のほう
patterns.span: タマムシ　シティの　ほう
patterns.explanation: のほう after a place makes it vague: the general direction or area of it. タマムシ シティの ほう = 'over Celadon City way'.

patterns.name: 〜でも
patterns.explanation: で says where something happens, and も adds 'too' on top of it. ほう でも = 'over that way as well'.
